# /crav1-tighten-plan

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a spec to a plan](../../from-spec-to-plan.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-tighten-plan/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Walk plan.md/tasks.md issues one by one (including [`/crav1-review-plan`](crav1-review-plan.md) P#s).

One plan issue at a time; patches plan/tasks only (spec findings go to tighten-spec)

## Runs when

Plan findings, or mushy tasks. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: Plan, tasks, spec, and those findings.

Reads `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `spec.md`, and plan-review findings already in the chat.

## Writes

In short: The picked issue in `plan.md` or `tasks.md`.

Writes only the picked plan issue in `plan.md` or `tasks.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md` and application code alone.

Limits and exceptions: a spec-tagged finding is not patched here.
